UPDATED 2026-09-30 -- 'samplesheet' now points at a FIXED, hardcoded S3 URI for the CRC_Sample_SPATIA_Test dataset's samplesheet.csv, not a relative '$.dataset...' expression. Why: five consecutive Cirro runs (2026-09-30, PW_DATASET values c134311a/6c59b585/3a40ae70/51329dca/9f1b1d68 -- see run logs) each got a DIFFERENT, newly-minted dataset ID, even when launched via 'Analyze' directly from CRC_Sample_SPATIA_Test (whose own stable ID is 8ce58e3d-ef11-4079-8d81-1a429bf9d410). '$.dataset' in this file evidently always resolves to that new per-run dataset, never the source dataset the samplesheet was actually uploaded to -- so '$.dataset.s3|/samplesheet.csv' could never have worked, no matter how many times the samplesheet was re-uploaded. Confidence this is the real mechanism: ~90% (five consistent data points), though the WHY is still unconfirmed against Cirro internals -- worth asking Dima directly.

TRADEOFF, flagged not hidden: this hardcodes to ONE specific source dataset. It will NOT automatically follow if/when a different or newer source dataset is used -- whoever changes the raw data source needs to update this line's dataset ID to match. That defeats part of the point of routing through Cirro's native Samples feature (which was meant to make this automatic), so treat this as a deadline stopgap, not the final design -- worth revisiting with Dima once there's breathing room.

SECOND ASSUMPTION, also unconfirmed (~70% confidence): that a plain 's3://...' string with no '$.' prefix is passed through by Cirro as a literal value rather than requiring the '$.dataset.s3|/path' expression syntax specifically. If this run fails differently (e.g. the literal string itself shows up somewhere instead of being resolved), that assumption was wrong and this needs a different approach entirely -- check the 'Workflow Parameters' panel for what 'samplesheet' actually resolved to before assuming anything else is broken.
